Quick internal note — sketched a margin matrix we should include in the CSV. I prefer modeling both the monthly ramp and the Q1-frontloaded options so ClearBay can pick. Key assumptions below:

- List price per 1k tokens (baseline): $0.020 (for pricing anchor)
- Committed discount tiers: 10% (0-1M), 18% (1M-5M), 28% (5M+)
- Distributor fee: 6% of list price (pre-discount)
- Reseller passback: 60% of the available channel pool after distributor fee (i.e., passback = 0.6 * (list * discount_amount - distributor_fee))
- ClearBay net: remainder after reseller

ASCII quick example for a single SKU at 1M tokens with 10% commit:
List = 0.020
Discount = 10% -> price = 0.018
Distributor fee = 0.0012 (6% of 0.020)
Channel pool = (list - price) - distributor_fee = (0.002) - 0.0012 = 0.0008
Reseller passback = 0.6 * 0.0008 = 0.00048
ClearBay net uplift = 0.00032

Notes/asks for Irene: please check VAT handling and whether distributor fees should be computed on list or effective price in EU. If taxes need gross-up, we need to reflect that in the CSV columns.

Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts
ben_carter@redwood.ai
